Guideline: Use the 23 canonical Omarchy subthemes from crates/yolo-shared
Description: submodules/omarchy and crates/yolo-shared define 23 official Omarchy themes (tokyo-night default, catppuccin, catppuccin-latte, ethereal, everforest, flexoki-light, gruvbox, hackerman, osaka-jade, kanagawa, last-horizon, lumon, lupine, matte-black, miasma, nord, retro-82, ristretto, rose-pine, solitude, starship, vantablack, white)
Do: Resolve palettes via OmarchySubTheme::from_id(name) or bun ui theme --preset omarchy --omarchy <subtheme>
Don't: Invent ad-hoc terminal hex colors that drift from the user's active Omarchy colors.toml
Code Bad: let bg = "#111111"; // unaligned with Omarchy colors.toml

Guideline: Use sharp 0px–2px TUI-modern geometry and 2px borders
Description: YoloStyle::for_preset(YoloThemePreset::Omarchy) specifies radius_sm: 0px, radius_md: 0px, radius_lg: 2px, border_width: 2px, and an 8px spacing grid
Do: Keep cards, modals, Waybar modules and Walker launchers crisp with 0px–2px corners and distinct 2px active/subtle borders
Don't: Apply 24px pill corners or heavy drop shadows that clash with Omarchy's TUI-modern aesthetic

Guideline: Pair Geist Variable with JetBrains Mono Variable / CaskaydiaMono Nerd Font
Description: Omarchy surfaces use monospace-forward hierarchy ('JetBrains Mono Variable', 'CaskaydiaMono Nerd Font') for status bars, keybinding hints, tables and command palettes
Do: Use --font-mono for labels, badges, keycaps, metrics and terminal panes, and --font-sans ('Geist Variable') for long-form prose
Don't: Use decorative serif or rounded display fonts in an Omarchy workspace
Code Good: font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'CaskaydiaMono Nerd Font', monospace);

Guideline: Synchronize Waybar, Walker, Hyprland, Ghostty and web apps from one bundle
Description: crates/yolo-emit (emit_omarchy_subtheme) emits [omarchy.colors] TOML, @define-color GTK/Waybar variables, and :root --t-* CSS tokens in one bundle
Do: Emit the unified omarchy-theme.bundle with bun ui theme --preset omarchy --target omarchy so all desktop and web surfaces match
Don't: Maintain separate hand-edited color palettes for Waybar, Ghostty, Neovim and web apps
Code Good: bun ui theme --preset omarchy --omarchy osaka-jade --target omarchy
Code Bad: // manually editing 6 different dotfiles with mismatched hex codes

Guideline: Bind web and Tauri apps to --t-* and --yolo-* CSS variables
Do: Style components with var(--t-bg), var(--t-surface), var(--t-brand) and var(--t-text)
Don't: Hardcode Tokyo Night hex values (#1a1b26, #7aa2f7) so switching to Catppuccin Latte or Flexoki Light fails
Code Good: background: var(--t-surface); color: var(--t-text); border-color: var(--t-brand);
Code Bad: background: #1a1b26; color: #a9b1d6; // breaks on light subthemes

Guideline: Support the 4 light Omarchy subthemes cleanly
Description: catppuccin-latte, flexoki-light, lupine and white are light-mode subthemes (is_dark == false in OmarchySubThemeSpec)
Do: Check subtheme.spec().is_dark and verify 4.5:1 text contrast in both dark (tokyo-night, vantablack) and light (flexoki-light, catppuccin-latte) subthemes
Don't: Assume every Omarchy theme has a dark background and hardcode white text
Code Bad: color: #ffffff; // invisible on Omarchy white & flexoki-light

Guideline: Design keyboard-first command palettes and mnemonic key hints
Description: Omarchy workflows center on Super+Space (Walker launcher), Super+W, and keyboard-driven tiling without requiring the mouse
Do: Expose visible [k] / Super+K shortcut badges and full arrow/Ctrl+N/Ctrl+P navigation in every list and dialog
Don't: Build mouse-only hover menus or hide primary actions behind unmarked icons
Code Bad: // hover-only dropdown with no keyboard shortcut

Description: TUI-inspired dashboards and system monitors (btop, Waybar, NSH) prioritize zero wasted chrome and clear tabular metrics
Do: Use --density 8..10 in design-system generation and tabular-nums for CPU/memory/network/financial readouts
Don't: Add oversized hero banners or decorative stock illustrations inside utility apps
Code Bad: // 400px decorative hero banner in a developer tool

Guideline: Leverage submodules/awesome-omarchy for community modules and themes
Description: submodules/awesome-omarchy catalogs vetted Waybar modules, Walker plugins, Ghostty shaders and custom Omarchy themes
Do: Search bundled patterns with bun ui awesome omarchy before building custom shell applets
Don't: Reinvent system tray or media player scripts from scratch without checking awesome-omarchy
Code Bad: // writing a custom unvetted bash polling loop for Waybar

Description: YoloManifest::with_omarchy_subtheme(subtheme) sets YoloThemePreset::Omarchy, syncs dark_mode from the subtheme spec, and activates hyprland-blur vibrancy
Do: Initialize the app manifest with YoloManifest::new(id, title).with_omarchy_subtheme(OmarchySubTheme::TokyoNight)
Don't: Configure preset, dark_mode and seed separately with inconsistent values
Code Bad: // manual mismatched seed and dark_mode flags
